About.label: About NorthSun
About.title: EPC with a Nordic accent
About.lead: A Czech-Swedish-Norwegian firm focused on solar.
About.body: Unlike typical installation contractors, we produce our own technical documentation and structural calculations in-house. We work in PV syst and PV sol, and we run every project from the first feasibility study through to handover. Our team speaks eight languages and trains every year at Intersolar in Munich.

Services.label: What we do
Services.title: Six product lines, one engineering team
Services.lead: From family homes to utility-scale parks. Always with in-house documentation and structural design.

items.title: Residential
items.description: Rooftop PV for family homes, sized for actual consumption and built to last.

items.title: Solar parks
items.description: Utility-scale parks, agri-PV, brownfield sites and commercial rooftops for investors and developers.

items.title: Solar parking and carports
items.description: Covered parking that generates electricity and adds value to existing surfaces.

items.title: Solar facades and BIPV
items.description: Photovoltaics integrated into the building envelope. An architectural element and an energy source.

items.title: Floating solar (FPV)
items.description: Installations on water surfaces, lagoons and reservoirs without taking up arable land.

items.title: Repairs and re-engineering
items.description: Diagnostics, remediation and redesign of existing plants underperforming due to poor delivery.

Why.label: Why NorthSun
Why.title: An engineering firm, not a crew with ladders
Why.lead: Four reasons clients hire us for projects others turn down.

items.title: Engineering-led EPC
items.description: In-house technical documentation, structural calculations and PV syst simulations. We don't outsource the decisions that matter.

items.title: International experience
items.description: References in Germany, the Netherlands, Sweden, Norway, Belgium and Croatia. We work where the project makes sense, regardless of borders.

items.title: Certified quality
items.description: We hold a PanelClaw certification for the successful installation of their mounting systems. Quality on paper, not just in pitch decks.

items.title: Multilingual team
items.description: We communicate in eight languages and train every year at Intersolar in Munich. We follow the technology where it's made.

References.label: Our work
References.title: Projects across Europe
References.lead: A selection of our own deliveries and partner projects.

items.title: Walraven
items.description: Solar facade and rooftop for the Walraven industrial site, combining BIPV with a conventional rooftop PV system.

items.title: Utility-scale solar park
items.description: Large-scale park with mounted structures, engineered for maximum yield in southern climate conditions.

items.title: Solar park
items.description: A park built for Scandinavian conditions with structural design tuned to local loads and year-round yield.

items.title: Rooftop installation
items.description: Rooftop photovoltaics adapted to Nordic climate and snow loading.

items.title: Floating PV plant
items.description: A floating photovoltaic installation on a water surface, with no need to occupy farmland.

items.title: Sunsurf, floating PV
items.description: A joint project covering floating PV and piling-free installation on a former landfill site.

Partners.label: Partners and certifications
Partners.title: We work with leading manufacturers in the industry
Partners.lead: A PanelClaw certification, a partnership with Sunsurf and Solar SK. Our suppliers know who they're letting into their projects.
